text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed on /v1/generate across multiple regions. P99 latency up, error ratio > 6% for the last 5m. Paging on-call.
alice: I'm looking. seeing spikes in 502/504s and a lot of upstream timeouts from the runtime layer.
ben: can you paste the top error traces? I see a bunch of KV timeout errors in the runtime logs earlier.
carla: initial glance at metrics: prefix-cache hit rate dropped from ~95% to ~20% -> huge increase in cold-paths. Correlates with error spike.
dave-oncall: @alice @ben I'm on it. grabbing logs from nodes in r-ams and r-dfw.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: recent config rollout: cache-ttl-adjust 2026-03-14T22:12 by infra-cfg (ver 1.3.7) — changed eviction heuristic to be more aggressive.
eva-support: support: customers reporting high error rates in UK and EU, some endpoints returning 502. Tickets created for top 3 affected accounts (acct-***).
alice: logs show repeated prefix-cache evictions and shard rebalances around 22:15. Here's a filtered snippet:
```
[22:15:07] prefix-cache: evict prefix="/model/foo" reason="ttl_expired" node=cache-12
[22:15:07] kv-client: read timeout after 3000ms for key=prefix:/model/foo shard=7
[22:15:08] runtime: upstream write failed: context deadline exceeded
[22:15:09] prefix-cache: eviction-loop detected, burst=128 evictions/s
```
ben: also seeing some checksum mismatches reported by the prefix-cache validator on cache-12.
carla: checksum mismatches -> possible partial corruption on in-memory entries after eviction+restore. Could be causing KV client retries which timeout the request path.
dave-oncall: immediate mitigations recommended?
alice: suggestions:
- disable aggressive eviction rollout (rollback infra-cfg ver 1.3.7 -> 1.3.6)
- temporarily increase KV client timeouts to 6s for read path
- for critical tier customers, route traffic to fallback cold-path with higher concurrency but stable behavior
- throttle incoming requests per-route to bring down pressure
ben: I'm starting rollback of eviction heuristic now. issuing:
```
infractl apply-config --service=prefix-cache --version=1.3.6 --reason="rollback-eviction-spike"
```
infra-bot: Config apply queued to pool-1, rolling to 10% -> 50% -> 100% across regions. ETA 4m.
carla: while rollback in flight, we should tag cache-12 and cache-14 as unhealthy to avoid further corruption propagation.
dave-oncall: marking nodes out of rotation: `cachectl drain cache-12 cache-14` executed.
eva-support: updating customers: initial impact estimate: ~8% of requests across EU/UK, affecting 12 paying customers intermittently. Support message drafted.
frank-product: flagging possible SLA breach for enterprise customers — prepping comms with legal.
alice: digging into KV client stack traces. pattern: on miss, prefix-cache tries to repopulate from shard leader; leader sometimes returns partial payload -> length mismatch -> validator logs checksum error -> eviction immediately triggered -> hot loop.
ben: I found a related code path in prefix-cache where a nil-check was skipped during streaming restore. pushing a hotfix to canary branch.
carla: hotfix: add guard for partial restores + exponential backoff on eviction loops. patch ready, but need canary validation.
dave-oncall: for immediate relief, we've disabled streaming restores on affected nodes. command:
```
cachectl set-config --node cache-12 --key streaming_restore --value false
```
infra-bot: streaming_restore disabled on cache-12 and cache-14.
alice: after rollback + disabling streaming restores, hit-rate slowly climbing: now ~60% and error ratio dropping to ~2.1%.
eva-support: support update sent to affected customers. message includes suggested retry behavior and ETA for deeper RCA.
frank-product: good to update contacts. prepping status page note: "Partial service degradation in EU/UK, mitigation in progress." waiting for SRE confirmation before posting.
ben: running synthetic load against /v1/generate to validate. small script used:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
```
carla: load results: p95 stable, p99 back to normal for canary nodes. still waiting on full rollout.
dave-oncall: current customer impact estimate down to 1.2% after config rollout completed. still P1 until fully resolved.
alice: RCA hypothesis: aggressive eviction heuristic introduced in 1.3.7 caused eviction storms when combined with streaming restore bug; storms led to repeated cache repop attempts, partial restores triggered checksum failures -> increased KV latency and gateway timeouts.
ben: action items for handoff to next on-call (ETA 30m):
- monitor error rate and prefix-cache hit-rate dashboards
- keep streaming_restore disabled on cache-12/14 until patch validated
- deploy patch to canary then prod once validated
- run offline integrity check on affected cache nodes
- follow up with infra team on safer rollout gating for cache configs
- update status page when SRE signs off
carla: I've pushed the patch to canary and started integration tests. logs will be saved to /var/logs/prefix-cache/patch-1977770000.log
dave-oncall: handing off to @ben for the next 2h window. Summary: rollback done, streaming restore disabled on affected nodes, patch in canary, customer impact reduced to ~1.2%. Keep P1 until p99 errors <0.5% and hit-rate >90% for 15m.
ben: ack. I'll keep monitoring and run the integrity check at 1977772000. Leaving detailed checklist in rotation notes.
eva-support: support backlog: 6 follow-ups to close with customers once full resolution confirmed.
incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff recorded. incident severity P1. Pager duty: ben -> next. Incident thread archived after resolution.
